findings.message: chart.labelling direct departs from the procedure, which gives legend (clustered bars take a legend row above the plot: a label per bar would each need a leader (G5.7, G7.5, D-7))

findings.message: the unit phrase “employees” is one word; say what is counted, which subset and per what period
findings.title: a unit phrase specific enough for one reading

source.shows: the book's “messy” version: each series named beside its bar of the last cluster, every label on a leader; drawn with the guided finding that clustered bars take a legend (G5.7)
